students.reg_notes: She signed up directly for mentorship from the VSL line so hasn't done anything with us at all yet. Brand new. Took lessons as a kid for 6 years but didn't really learn. She is 73 and retired now and wants to be able to really pour herself into being able to create and play music on the piano. She wants to learn to play the blues primarily. She DOES NOT want to have to study a bunch of theory, and specifically mentioned not wanting to have to spend a bunch of time on scales, circle of fifths, music theory, etc. wants her experience to be mainly practical. I know we have those things in our program but it is vital that her mentor helps her learn these things if needed in a very fun and practical way. She wants to start in a couple month cause she doesnt have the piano.

students.name: Tam Truong
students.reg_notes: She is vietnamese and ESL but speaks pretty good English. She is verrrry shy. Needs someone very patient and kind to work with her. She is 73 so will need some extra TLC to set up anything technical to make the mentorship work. Was soooo thankful to be able to do the Mentorship. She spent 3 hours on the phone with me trying to make it go right, going to the bank, trying to apply for Klarna, etc. etc. Went through a lot to get this service. I want to service her very well!

students.name: Carolyn Tormey
students.reg_notes: She wants a very kind and caring coach. She was interested in Nashville so could be turned into a bigger cycle if really taken care of. The reason she didn't pay in full is because she is a multi-time cancer survivor and is about to go in for cancer treatments again. She is very emotional about this and wants music to be her healing power and outlet. Stressed this a lot so her coach needs to know this about her. She wanted me to really communicate everything about her and be a part of her coach selection process. She needs someone who she can really communicate with and tell her story to and will help her let herself go in her music and heal. This is do or die for her so whoever her coach is needs to be really caring and interested in her well-being.
